set.body: First bounded P2.2 slice in port/docs/roadmap.md. Add recorded proposal-to-admitted part-whole, temporal, causal and reference relations using shared graph contracts; preserve evidence/context and reject foreign endpoints and prohibited cycles. Acceptance: positive/refusal witnesses per supported relation family, saved graph readback, analysis/inspection readout. Place/state/time and playback/discontinuous support remain P2 obligations scheduled as separate slices, not silently bundled or excluded.
set.title: P2.2 Admit typed relation proposals into source and recall graphs
